name: Account Ownership Type 5 Code
definition: Specifies the type of account ownership.

USUF.name: Usufructuary
USUF.definition: Person having the temporary right to use and derive income or benefit from someone else's property.

OWNR.name: Owner
OWNR.definition: A person has full ownership on the asset.

BOWN.name: Bare Owner
BOWN.definition: A person has bare ownership on the asset.
